commentary.text: 90+12' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+9' Ayoze Perez (Betis) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the right-hand post. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Vicente Guaita with a fabulous save. German Pezzella (Betis) misses a rebound from close range. His effort floats narrowly over the crossbar!
90+9' Marc Roca (Betis) prepares to take a corner kick.
90+8' Marc Roca (Betis) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
90+6' 2 - 1 Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) gets one-on-one with the goalkeeper and takes an early shot which finds the back of the net.
90+3' Luiz Henrique (Betis) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Ayoze Perez, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
90+1' Sokratis Papastathopoulos (Betis) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
90+1' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo), but his powerful first-time shot flies well wide of the left post.
90' We will have 10 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Jorgen Strand Larsen will be replaced by Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo).
89' Rafael Benitez decides to make a substitution. Carles Perez will be replaced by Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo).
89' Substitution. Rodri (Betis) in, Isco out.
89' The goal by Celta Vigo is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
84' Wait! Referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
82' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
82' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) will take a corner kick.

81' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
79' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) does well to meet the corner from Iago Aspas, but his close-range header is soft and goes miles wide of the right post.
79' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

78' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Celta Vigo force a corner. They send men into the box.
77' Isco (Betis) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

76' Sergi Altimira (Betis) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
76' Isco (Betis) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
74' The substitution is prepared. Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Fran Beltran.
74' Isco (Betis) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
73' Isco (Betis) takes a short corner kick.
72' Luiz Henrique (Betis) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
69' Isco (Betis) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
68' The linesman signals that Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
67' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) takes a long run up and launches the free kick towards goal from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall bravely blocks the effort.
67' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Franco Cervi limps off the pitch to be replaced by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
66' Manuel Pellegrini prepares a substitution. William Carvalho is replaced by Sergi Altimira (Betis).
65' Ayoze Perez (Betis) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Isco, but Vicente Guaita displays great awareness to stop him.
64' Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) has a sight of goal and shoots from distance, but Rui Silva is equal to it.
58' Here is a change. Borja Iglesias is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Willian Jose (Betis).
58' Substitution. Assane Diao walks off the pitch and Luiz Henrique (Betis) comes on as a substitute.
58' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
55' Celta Vigo are ruled offside.
55' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes it short.
55' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo win a corner kick.
54' The resulting corner from Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
54' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

53' Rui Silva makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom right corner.
52' A dangerous looking corner kick from Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is cleared to safety by the defence.
51' Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) tries to find Jorgen Strand Larsen, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
49' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) finds some space inside the box and produces a first-time shot that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
48' The attendance for today's match is 21105.

47' Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the top left corner. Unfortunately for him, Rui Silva makes a great save to stop his effort.
46' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) has a go from distance but he can't find the target as it goes well wide of the left post.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' The ball breaks to Assane Diao (Betis) after a scramble in the box, but his first-time effort is immediately blocked.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Isco (Betis) tries to find Assane Diao, but he puts too much power on the pass.
44' A free kick into the box, taken by Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo), is comfortably cleared by the opposition's defence.
43' A clumsy foul by Sokratis Papastathopoulos (Betis) and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle. Celta Vigo win a free kick.
42' Isco (Betis) takes the corner but it's cleared.
38' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
38' The resulting corner from Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) comes to nothing.

37' Isco (Betis) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball. One of the players from Betis times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
37' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) brings an opponent down and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias interrupts the game. That's a free kick to Betis.
35' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) fails to convert the free kick from the edge of the box. His shot goes right into the stands. High, wide and not at all handsome.
34' Celta Vigo have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
33' William Carvalho (Betis) has tested the patience of referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
33' William Carvalho (Betis) attempts to feed Ayoze Perez with a chip pass, but Vicente Guaita reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
31' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) receives the ball from Jorgen Strand Larsen and tries to beat the keeper from long range, but the effort goes high over the bar.
29' Ayoze Perez (Betis) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
27' Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo) sends a long ball forward to Carles Perez, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is behind the touchline and Betis will take a throw-in.

26' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
25' Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Franco Cervi.
25' The total number of attempts is 3:1. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:1.
21' Good play from Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) gives him some space for the shot from distance, but it's lacking accuracy and goes well wide of the left post.
18' Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) cracks a volley from just outside the box, but his miskick goes skyward.
16' 1 - 1 Goal! Rui Silva gets a hand on the penalty from Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
15' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

15' Borja Iglesias (Betis) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Celta Vigo.
14' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
14' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo will have a chance to score from a corner.
11' That looked a certain handball by Abner (Betis) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
10' Neat link-up play between Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) and Iago Aspas, but Rui Silva reads the game well and the move breaks down.
9' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
6' 0 - 1 Goal! Isco tees up Aitor Ruibal (Betis) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 0:1.
4' Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball has crossed the sideline. Betis are taking a throw-in.
3' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul after German Pezzella (Betis) hacks down one of his opponents.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Betis will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias.
